resolution.note: PATH krn links to .krn/product-release/bin/krn; Product bin/krn state forwards to the installed legacy release until t-3yss2y9; host link switched after merge

title: Point krn on PATH at the repository CLI
body:
Outcome: `command -v krn` resolves to this repository's CLI (or a current sealed release of it); `krn nosuchcmd` exits 64 with nothing on stdout (KRN-06) and `krn ledger --help` works.
Why: ~/.local/bin/krn runs the legacy release ~/.codex/krn/releases/1eb17b8…/scripts/krn.mjs: unknown commands print 25 usage lines on stdout, and ledger, worker, eval and review only print usage (observed 2026-11-09). Lead skills call global `krn state` and `krn task`.
Proof: the two commands above, outputs recorded under .krn/runs/.
Scope: this repository plus the host link (standing install grant, memory krn-install-seal); back up the old link first.
